# AGENTS.md

Pure-Bun Codex gateway: ChatCompletions <-> Responses for the Codex desktop/CLI
app, zero npm dependencies. Declared models route to chat (OpenAI-compatible)
*or* Responses providers; undeclared models pass through to the signed-in
ChatGPT backend. Distributed as a compiled binary (`bun run build` ->
`codextras`); run it wherever you install it and state/, logs/,
codextras.json resolve next to it.

## Commands

    codextras start|stop|status       daemonize via pidfile
    codextras catalog                 declared-models catalog
    codextras catalog-merged          capture native catalog + write state/merged-models.json
    codextras dry-run [alias]         render future config.toml without writing
    codextras apply [alias]           backup + switch ~/.codex/config.toml to codextras
    codextras restore                 restore the pre-codextras config.toml
    bun run build                     compile the binary (src/cli.mjs)
    bun test                          unit tests (stop the gateway first: port conflict)
    ./smoke/verify-after-switch.sh    live checks (needs gateway running + real upstream key)

## Architecture

    src/server.mjs          Bun.serve: /v1/responses, /v1/responses/compact, /v1/models, WS refused with 426
    src/adapter.mjs         chat + Responses builders (thinking envelope, efforts, include, store, stream_options)
    src/convert/request.mjs Responses items -> chat messages (reasoning, tools, images, compaction) + flattenToolsForResponses
    src/convert/tools.mjs   custom/freeform tool bridge (exec etc.)
    src/convert/stream.mjs  chat SSE -> Responses SSE lifecycle (responses upstream is proxied verbatim)
    src/convert/json.mjs    non-streaming chat -> Responses
    src/catalog.mjs         catalog entry generation + native merge + visibility overrides (supports_reasoning_summaries toggleable)
    src/codex-config.mjs    config.toml managed-block rendering
    src/compaction.mjs      compaction v1/v2 with kcr1: summary envelope (chat or responses per provider)

## Onboarding: configure a model

Edit `codextras.json`. Providers are OpenAI-compatible chat **or Responses**
endpoints; `provider.type` (or `wireApi`/`api`) selects the wire format.
`type: "openai-chat"` (default) → `/chat/completions` with Chat↔Responses
bridging (needed for DeepSeek); `type: "openai-responses"` →
`/responses` with verbatim Responses passthrough (needed for Muse Spark,
preserves `reasoning.encrypted_content` + true multimodal). All three
dimensions are toggleable per-model: vision via `inputModalities` +
`imagePassthrough`, wire format via `provider.type` *or* `model.wireApi`/`model.api`,
and reasoning via `reasoningInjection`/`disableThoughtHack` +
`reasoningSummary`/`supportsReasoningSummaries`. Quirks carry per-provider
differences as data (thinking envelope, effort aliases, stream_options,
`include`). Relative `apiKeyFile` paths resolve against the repo root.

Example (opencode-go provider + DeepSeek V4 Flash):

```json
{
  "gateway": { "port": 4200, "pathPrefix": "/_codextras" },
  "providers": [
    {
      "id": "opencode-go",
      "type": "openai-chat",
      "baseUrl": "https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1",
      "apiKeyEnv": ["OPENCODE_API_KEY", "OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY"],
      "apiKeyFile": "./state/opencode-go-api-key.secret",
      "quirks": {
        "thinking": { "type": "enabled" },
        "efforts": { "low": "low", "high": "high", "max": "max" },
        "streamOptions": true
      }
    }
  ],
  "models": [
    {
      "alias": "deepseek-flash",
      "displayName": "V4 Flash",
      "provider": "opencode-go",
      "upstreamModel": "deepseek-v4-flash",
      "contextWindow": 1048576,
      "autoCompact": 900000,
      "efforts": ["low", "high", "max"],
      "defaultEffort": "high",
      "inputModalities": ["text", "image"],
      "imagePassthrough": false
    }
  ]
}
```

Then `codextras apply <alias>` and restart the Codex app (it caches the
catalog). `catalogOverrides` can force native-model visibility (e.g.
`{"gpt-5.2": {"visibility": "hide"}}`).

Dual-provider example (DeepSeek on chat + Muse Spark on Responses, same key):

```json
{
  "providers": [
    { "id": "opencode-go-chat", "type": "openai-chat", "baseUrl": "https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1", "apiKeyEnv": ["OPENCODE_API_KEY"], "quirks": { "thinking": { "type": "enabled" }, "efforts": { "low": "low", "high": "high", "max": "max" } } },
    { "id": "opencode-go-responses", "type": "openai-responses", "baseUrl": "https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1", "apiKeyEnv": ["OPENCODE_API_KEY"], "quirks": { "efforts": { "minimal": "minimal", "low": "low", "medium": "medium", "high": "high", "xhigh": "xhigh" }, "include": ["reasoning.encrypted_content"], "reasoningSummary": "auto", "store": false } }
  ],
  "models": [
    { "alias": "deepseek-flash", "provider": "opencode-go-chat", "upstreamModel": "deepseek-v4-flash", "efforts": ["low","high","max"], "defaultEffort": "high", "inputModalities": ["text","image"], "imagePassthrough": false },
    { "alias": "muse-spark", "provider": "opencode-go-responses", "upstreamModel": "muse-spark-1.2", "efforts": ["minimal","low","medium","high","xhigh"], "defaultEffort": "high", "inputModalities": ["text","image"], "imagePassthrough": true, "supportsReasoningSummaries": true, "reasoningSummary": "auto" }
  ]
}
```
Alternative single-provider toggle: set `"api": "responses"` (or `wireApi`/`targetApi`) per `models[]` entry to override the provider’s wire format — same `type` field works per-model. Vision (`imagePassthrough`), wire format, and `<thought>` hack are all toggleable.

## Hard-won constraints

- The managed block in config.toml must stay at the TOP of the file: root keys
  (`openai_base_url`, `model_catalog_json`) land inside whatever table precedes
  them otherwise, and Codex silently ignores them.
- Reasoning is preserved twice for **chat** providers: `reasoning_content` on
  assistant messages (the DeepSeek API contract when tools are present) AND a
  visible `<thought>` block (the model's only real memory). Never use
  `<think>`: the upstream's reasoning parser strips that exact tag from
  assistant content. **Responses** providers (Muse Spark) do not use this
  hack — they replay `reasoning.encrypted_content` via `include` + `store:false`
  and should disable it with `reasoningInjection:"none"` / `disableThoughtHack`.
  Muse’s `summary` is empty today (encrypted only).
- Custom tools (exec) are advertised as functions with a single required
  `content` string property and returned as `custom_tool_call` items (see
  convert/tools.mjs). This mirrors the proven LiteLLM bridge; the app's tool
  router rejects plain `function_call` items for freeform tools.
- Catalog entries require `experimental_supported_tools` and should set
  `prefer_websockets: false`; Codex falls back to its built-in catalog if the
  file fails to parse.
- WebSocket upgrades get `426` on purpose: Codex falls back to HTTP streaming
  immediately. Do not add a WS endpoint.
- `state/` and `logs/` hold secrets (gateway token, provider API key, catalog
  JSONs). Never commit them.

## Verification loop

1. `codextras stop && bun test && codextras start`
2. `./smoke/verify-after-switch.sh` (health, config.toml root keys, catalog,
   real upstream turn, compaction, WS 426)
3. `codextras apply <alias>`, then the Codex app must be fully quit and
   reopened to reload the catalog.

## Conventions

Bun-only, no npm dependencies, no build step. Match the existing style (ESM,
plain functions, minimal abstraction). Add unit tests for conversion logic in
test/gateway.test.mjs; live behaviors belong in the smoke script.

116: async function* sseEvents(body) {
117:   const reader = body.getReader();
118:   const decoder = new TextDecoder();
119:   let buffer = "";
120:   while (true) {
121:     const { done, value } = await reader.read();
122:     if (done) break;
123:     buffer += decoder.decode(value, { stream: true });
124:     let index;
125:     while ((index = buffer.indexOf("\n\n")) >= 0) {
126:       const block = buffer.slice(0, index);
127:       buffer = buffer.slice(index + 2);
128:       const data = block
129:         .split("\n")
130:         .map((line) => line.replace(/\r$/, ))
131:         .filter((line) => line.startsWith("data:"))
132:         .map((line) => line.slice(5).trimStart())

135:         try {
136:           yield JSON.parse(data);
137:         } catch {
138:           // Ignore malformed SSE blocks; the stream continues.

215: function mapResponsesItemForCodex(item, toolNames, customNames) {
216:   if (!item || typeof item !== "object") return item;
217:   const t = item.type;
218:   if (t !== "function_call" && t !== "custom_tool_call") return item;
219:   let name = item.name;
220:   let callId = item.call_id || item.id;
221:   let rawArgs = item.arguments;
222:   if (typeof rawArgs !== "string" && rawArgs !== undefined && rawArgs !== null && typeof rawArgs === "object") {
223:     try {
224:       rawArgs = JSON.stringify(rawArgs);
225:     } catch {
226:       rawArgs = "";
227:     }
228:   }
229:   let args = typeof rawArgs === "string" ? rawArgs : typeof item.input === "string" ? item.input : "";
230:   // If upstream returned flat name (collaboration__spawn_agent), map to namespaced for Codex
231:   const mapped = toolNames instanceof Map ? toolNames.get(name) : undefined;
232:   const fallback = !mapped ? mapToolName(name) : undefined;
233:   const target = mapped || fallback;
234:   if (target) {
235:     name = target.name;
236:     item = { ...item, name, namespace: target.namespace };
237:   }
238:   // Custom tools: Codex expects custom_tool_call with raw input, not function_call with JSON
239:   const isCustom = customNames instanceof Set && customNames.has(name);
240:   if (isCustom) {
241:     const raw = item.type === "custom_tool_call" ? item.input : unwrapCustomToolArguments(args);
242:     return {
243:       id: callId,
244:       type: "custom_tool_call",
245:       status: item.status || "completed",
246:       call_id: callId,
247:       name,
248:       input: raw,
249:     };
250:   }
251:   if (t === "custom_tool_call" && !isCustom) {
252:     // Upstream mistakenly returned custom for a non-custom tool — normalize to function_call
253:     let normalized;
254:     if (typeof item.input === "string") {
255:       const trimmed = item.input.trim();
256:       if (!trimmed) normalized = "{}";
257:       else {
258:         try {
259:           JSON.parse(trimmed);
260:           normalized = trimmed;
261:         } catch {
262:           normalized = JSON.stringify({ content: item.input });
263:           try {
264:             JSON.parse(normalized);
265:           } catch {
266:             normalized = "{}";
267:           }
268:         }
269:       }
270:     } else {
271:       normalized = normalizeArgsForCodex(args);
272:     }
273:     return {
274:       id: callId,
275:       type: "function_call",
276:       status: item.status || "completed",
277:       call_id: callId,
278:       name,
279:       arguments: normalized,
280:       ...(item.namespace ? { namespace: item.namespace } : target ? { namespace: target.namespace } : {}),
281:     };
282:   }
283:   // Ensure function_call has arguments string
284:   if (isCustom) return item;
285:   return {
286:     ...item,
287:     name,
288:     arguments: normalizeArgsForCodex(args),
289:     ...(target && !item.namespace ? { namespace: target.namespace } : {}),
290:   };
291: }

313: async function streamResponsesTurn(upstream, { model, requestBytes, toolNames, customNames }) {
314:   const encoder = new TextEncoder();
315:   const decoder = new TextDecoder();
316:   // We need to rewrite tool names on the fly while proxying raw SSE.
317:   // Responses SSE is `event: <type>\ndata: <json>\n\n` — we parse each block, map tool items, re-emit.
318:   const reader = upstream.body.getReader();
319:   let buffer = "";
320:   let sawCompleted = false;
321:   let streamError = null;
322:   const stream = new ReadableStream({
323:     async start(controller) {
324:       try {
325:         while (true) {
326:           const { done, value } = await reader.read();
327:           if (done) break;
328:           buffer += decoder.decode(value, { stream: true });
329:           let idx;
330:           while ((idx = buffer.indexOf("\n\n")) >= 0) {
331:             const block = buffer.slice(0, idx);
332:             buffer = buffer.slice(idx + 2);
333:             if (!block.trim()) continue;
334:             const lines = block.split("\n");
335:             let event = "";
336:             let data = "";
337:             for (const line of lines) {
338:               if (line.startsWith("event:")) event = line.slice(6).trim();
339:               else if (line.startsWith("data:")) data = line.slice(5).trimStart();
340:             }
341:             if (!data || data === "[DONE]") {
342:               if (data === "[DONE]") controller.enqueue(encoder.encode("data: [DONE]\n\n"));
343:               continue;
344:             }
345:             let parsed;
346:             try {
347:               parsed = JSON.parse(data);
348:             } catch {
349:               controller.enqueue(encoder.encode(`event: ${event || "message"}\ndata: ${data}\n\n`));
350:               continue;
351:             }
352:             // Map tool call items in output_item events
353:             if (
354:               (event === "response.output_item.added" || event === "response.output_item.done") &&
355:               parsed.item &&
356:               (parsed.item.type === "function_call" || parsed.item.type === "custom_tool_call")
357:             ) {
358:               parsed.item = mapResponsesItemForCodex(parsed.item, toolNames, customNames);
359:               if (parsed.item.type === "function_call" && parsed.item.namespace) {
360:                 // Codex expects namespaced function_call to carry namespace alongside name
361:                 parsed.item.namespace = parsed.item.namespace;
362:               }
363:             }
364:             // Also handle response.completed's output array (some providers send it as event data)
365:             if (event === "response.completed" && parsed.response && Array.isArray(parsed.response.output)) {
366:               sawCompleted = true;
367:               parsed.response.output = parsed.response.output.map((it) => mapResponsesItemForCodex(it, toolNames, customNames));
368:               parsed.response.model = model;
369:             }
370:             if (event === "response.completed") sawCompleted = true;
371:             // Rewrite model in response.created/in_progress if present
372:             if ((event === "response.created" || event === "response.in_progress") && parsed.response) {
373:               parsed.response.model = model;
374:             }
375:             const outData = JSON.stringify(parsed);
376:             if (event) controller.enqueue(encoder.encode(`event: ${event}\ndata: ${outData}\n\n`));
377:             else controller.enqueue(encoder.encode(`data: ${outData}\n\n`));
378:           }
379:         }
380:         // Flush remainder
381:         if (buffer.trim()) {
382:           const lines = buffer.split("\n");
383:           let event = "";
384:           let data = "";
385:           for (const line of lines) {
386:             if (line.startsWith("event:")) event = line.slice(6).trim();
387:             else if (line.startsWith("data:")) data = line.slice(5).trimStart();
388:           }
389:           if (data && data !== "[DONE]") {
390:             try {
391:               let parsed = JSON.parse(data);
392:               if (parsed.item) parsed.item = mapResponsesItemForCodex(parsed.item, toolNames, customNames);
393:               if (parsed.response) sawCompleted = true;
394:               controller.enqueue(encoder.encode(`event: ${event}\ndata: ${JSON.stringify(parsed)}\n\n`));
395:             } catch {
396:               controller.enqueue(encoder.encode(buffer));
397:             }
398:           }
399:         }
400:       } catch (e) {
401:         streamError = e && e.message ? e.message : String(e);
402:         debugLog({ dir: "stream_error", wire: "responses", model, message: streamError });
403:       }
404:       if (streamError || !sawCompleted) {
405:         // Let client know the stream was truncated rather than pretending it completed cleanly
406:         const msg = streamError || "Upstream stream closed before response.completed";
407:         debugLog({ dir: "stream_aborted", wire: "responses", model, sawCompleted, message: msg });
408:         controller.enqueue(encoder.encode(`event: error\ndata: ${JSON.stringify({ error: { message: msg } })}\n\n`));
409:       }
410:       controller.enqueue(encoder.encode(sseDone()));
411:       controller.close();
412:     },
413:   });
414:   return new Response(stream, { headers: SSE_HEADERS });
415: }

1: // Native OpenAI passthrough: requests for models that are not declared in
2: // codextras.json are forwarded to the signed-in ChatGPT backend, exactly like
3: // codex-router does, so OpenAI models keep working alongside routed models.
4: 
5: const FORWARD_HEADERS = new Set([
6:   "authorization",
7:   "chatgpt-account-id",
8:   "openai-beta",
9:   "originator",
10:   "session_id",
11:   "session-id",
12:   "thread-id",
13:   "x-client-request-id",
14:   "x-codex-beta-features",
15:   "x-codex-installation-id",
16:   "x-codex-parent-thread-id",
17:   "x-codex-turn-metadata",
18:   "x-codex-turn-state",
19:   "x-codex-window-id",
20:   "x-oai-attestation",
21:   "x-openai-subagent",
22:   "x-responsesapi-include-timing-metrics",
23: ]);
24: 
25: export function nativeBase() {
26:   return String(
27:     process.env.CODEXTRAS_NATIVE_BASE_URL ||
28:       "https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex",
29:   ).replace(/\/+$/, "");
30: }
31: 
32: export function nativeTarget(apiPath, search) {
33:   const withoutV1 = apiPath.replace(/^\/v1(?=\/|$)/, "");
34:   return nativeBase() + withoutV1 + (search || "");
35: }
36: 
37: export function forwardedHeaders(request) {
38:   const headers = {
39:     "Content-Type": "application/json",
40:     "Accept-Encoding": "identity",
41:   };
42:   for (const name of FORWARD_HEADERS) {
43:     const value = request.headers.get(name);
44:     if (value !== undefined && value !== null && value !== "") {
45:       headers[name] = value;
46:     }
47:   }
48:   return headers;
49: }
50: 
51: export async function forwardNative(request, apiPath, rawBody) {
52:   const url = new URL(request.url);
53:   const target = nativeTarget(apiPath, url.search);
54:   const body = rawBody !== undefined ? rawBody : undefined;
55:   let res;
56:   try {
57:     res = await fetch(target, {
58:       method: request.method,
59:       headers: forwardedHeaders(request),
60:       body: request.method === "GET" ? undefined : body,
61:       signal: request.signal,
62:     });
63:   } catch (error) {
64:     const message = error && error.message ? error.message : String(error);
65:     return Response.json({ error: { message } }, { status: 502 });
66:   }
67:   const responseHeaders = new Headers();
68:   const contentType = res.headers.get("content-type");
69:   if (contentType) responseHeaders.set("content-type", contentType);
70:   return new Response(res.body, { status: res.status, headers: responseHeaders });
71: }

1: import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
2: import { effortFor } from "./config.mjs";
3: 
4: export function providerHeaders(provider) {
5:   const key = resolveKey(provider);
6:   return {
7:     "Content-Type": "application/json",
8:     Accept: "text/event-stream, application/json",
9:     ...(key ? { Authorization: "Bearer " + key } : {}),
10:   };
11: }
12: 
13: function resolveKey(provider) {
14:   const envs = Array.isArray(provider.apiKeyEnv) ? provider.apiKeyEnv : [provider.apiKeyEnv];
15:   for (const name of envs) {
16:     if (!name) continue;
17:     const value = process.env[name];
18:     if (value) return value;
19:   }
20:   if (provider.apiKeyFile) {
21:     try {
22:       return readFileSync(provider.apiKeyFile, "utf8").trim();
23:     } catch {
24:       return "";
25:     }
26:   }
27:   return "";
28: }
29: 
30: export function buildChatBody({ payload, model, provider, messages, tools, stream }) {
31:   const quirks = provider.quirks || {};
32:   const body = {
33:     model: model.upstreamModel,
34:     messages,
35:     stream,
36:   };
37:   if (tools && tools.length) {
38:     body.tools = tools;
39:     body.tool_choice = payload.tool_choice ?? "auto";
40:   }
41:   const requested = payload.reasoning && payload.reasoning.effort;
42:   const effort = effortFor(model, requested);
43:   if (model.reasoningContent !== false) {
44:     body.reasoning_effort = effort;
45:   }
46:   if (quirks.thinking) body.thinking = quirks.thinking;
47:   const effortMap = quirks.efforts;
48:   if (effortMap && typeof effortMap[effort] === "string") {
49:     body.reasoning_effort = effortMap[effort];
50:   }
51:   if (stream && quirks.streamOptions !== false) {
52:     body.stream_options = { include_usage: true };
53:   }
54:   const maxOutput = payload.max_output_tokens;
55:   if (maxOutput !== undefined && maxOutput !== null) body.max_tokens = maxOutput;
56:   return body;
57: }
58: 
59: export function isResponsesProvider(provider) {
60:   if (!provider || typeof provider !== "object") return false;
61:   const type = typeof provider.type === "string" ? provider.type.toLowerCase() : "";
62:   if (type.includes("responses")) return true;
63:   if (type === "openai" && provider.wireApi === "responses") return true;
64:   if (typeof provider.wireApi === "string" && provider.wireApi.toLowerCase() === "responses") return true;
65:   if (typeof provider.api === "string" && provider.api.toLowerCase() === "responses") return true;
66:   if (typeof provider.apiType === "string" && provider.apiType.toLowerCase() === "responses") return true;
67:   return false;
68: }
69: 
70: export function isResponsesModel(model, provider) {
71:   if (!model || typeof model !== "object") return isResponsesProvider(provider);
72:   const mApi =
73:     typeof model.api === "string"
74:       ? model.api
75:       : typeof model.wireApi === "string"
76:         ? model.wireApi
77:         : typeof model.apiType === "string"
78:           ? model.apiType
79:           : typeof model.targetApi === "string"
80:             ? model.targetApi
81:             : undefined;
82:   if (typeof mApi === "string") {
83:     const v = mApi.toLowerCase();
84:     if (v.includes("responses")) return true;
85:     if (v.includes("chat") || v.includes("completions")) return false;
86:   }
87:   return isResponsesProvider(provider);
88: }
89: 
90: export function responsesUrl(provider) {
91:   return String(provider.baseUrl).replace(/\/$/, "") + "/responses";
92: }
93: 
94: export function supportsResponsesCustomTools(model, provider) {
95:   for (const value of [
96:     model && model.supportsCustomTools,
97:     provider && provider.supportsCustomTools,
98:     provider && provider.quirks && provider.quirks.supportsCustomTools,
99:   ]) {
100:     if (typeof value === "boolean") return value;
101:   }
102:   return true;
103: }
104: 
105: export function buildResponsesBody({ payload, model, provider, input, tools, stream }) {
106:   const quirks = provider.quirks || {};
107:   const body = {
108:     model: model.upstreamModel,
109:     input,
110:     stream,
111:   };
112:   if (typeof payload.instructions === "string" && payload.instructions.trim()) {
113:     body.instructions = payload.instructions;
114:   }
115:   if (tools && tools.length) {
116:     body.tools = tools;
117:     body.tool_choice = payload.tool_choice ?? "auto";
118:   }
119:   const requested = payload.reasoning && payload.reasoning.effort;
120:   const effort = effortFor(model, requested);
121:   if (model.reasoningContent !== false && effort) {
122:     body.reasoning = { effort };
123:     // allow quirks.efforts alias (e.g. max -> xhigh)
124:     const effortMap = quirks.efforts;
125:     if (effortMap && typeof effortMap[effort] === "string") {
126:       body.reasoning.effort = effortMap[effort];
127:     }
128:     // optional summary control (e.g. "auto" for Muse)
129:     if (typeof quirks.reasoningSummary === "string") {
130:       body.reasoning.summary = quirks.reasoningSummary;
131:     } else if (typeof model.reasoningSummary === "string") {
132:       body.reasoning.summary = model.reasoningSummary;
133:     }
134:   }
135:   if (quirks.thinking) body.thinking = quirks.thinking;
136:   // encrypted reasoning replay (Muse Spark) — provider or model level
137:   const include = quirks.include || model.include;
138:   if (Array.isArray(include) && include.length) body.include = include;
139:   // stateless: do not require server-side storage
140:   if (quirks.store !== undefined) body.store = quirks.store;
141:   else if (model.store !== undefined) body.store = model.store;
142:   else body.store = false;
143:   if (payload.previous_response_id) body.previous_response_id = payload.previous_response_id;
144:   if (payload.truncation) body.truncation = payload.truncation;
145:   const maxOutput = payload.max_output_tokens;
146:   if (maxOutput !== undefined && maxOutput !== null) body.max_output_tokens = maxOutput;
147:   return body;
148: }
149: 
150: export function chatUrl(provider) {
151:   return String(provider.baseUrl).replace(/\/$/, "") + "/chat/completions";
152: }

1: import { existsSync, mkdirSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
2: import path from "node:path";
3: 
4: // In a compiled binary, import.meta.dir is a baked-in build-time path that
5: // does not exist at runtime; the codextras root is then the binary's own
6: // directory, so state/, logs/, codextras.json and relative apiKeyFile paths
7: // resolve next to the executable no matter where it is installed.
8: export function isCompiledBinary() {
9:   const execBase = path.basename(process.execPath || "");
10:   return execBase !== "bun" && execBase !== "bun.exe" && !/^bun[.-]/.test(execBase);
11: }
12: 
13: export const ROOT = path.resolve(
14:   isCompiledBinary() ? path.dirname(process.execPath) : path.join(import.meta.dir, ".."),
15: );
16: export const CONFIG_PATH =
17:   process.env.CODEXTRAS_CONFIG || path.join(ROOT, "codextras.json");
18: export const STATE_DIR = path.join(ROOT, "state");
19: export const SECRET_PATH = path.join(STATE_DIR, "secret");
20: export const LOG_PATH = path.join(ROOT, "logs", "codextras.log");
21: export const PID_PATH = path.join(STATE_DIR, "codextras.pid");
22: 
23: function loadJson(file) {
24:   return JSON.parse(readFileSync(file, "utf8"));
25: }
26: 
27: export function loadConfig() {
28:   const raw = loadJson(CONFIG_PATH);
29:   const gateway = raw.gateway || {};
30:   const port = Number(gateway.port ?? 4200);
31:   const pathPrefix = String(gateway.pathPrefix || "/_codextras").replace(/\/$/, "");
32:   return {
33:     gateway: { port, pathPrefix },
34:     providers: (Array.isArray(raw.providers) ? raw.providers : []).map((provider) => ({
35:       ...provider,
36:       // Relative apiKeyFile paths are resolved against the codextras root so
37:       // they work regardless of the gateway's working directory.
38:       apiKeyFile:
39:         provider &&
40:         typeof provider.apiKeyFile === "string" &&
41:         !path.isAbsolute(provider.apiKeyFile)
42:           ? path.resolve(ROOT, provider.apiKeyFile)
43:           : provider && provider.apiKeyFile,
44:     })),

412:   for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i += 1) {

426:             }

428:               role: "assistant",
429:               reasoning_content: pendingReasoning,
430:               content: null,

436:       }
437:       continue;

439:     flushVisible();

441:       addToolCall(item);

443:     }
444:     if (item.type === "function_call_output" || item.type === "custom_tool_call_output") {
445:       const callId = item.call_id || item.id;
446:       if (!callId || !callIds.has(callId) || seenOutputs.has(callId)) continue;
447:       seenOutputs.add(callId);
448:       let output = dropToolOutputImages(item.output, model);
449:       if (output && typeof output === "object") output = JSON.stringify(output);

469:       const summary = decodeSummary(item.encrypted_content);

472:         : "Earlier conversation history was compacted in an unreadable format.";

481:   if (pendingReasoning) {

493: function repairToolResults(messages) {

503:   const repaired = [];

505:     if (message.role === "tool") {
506:       if (emitted.has(message.tool_call_id)) continue;
507:       if (toolById.get(message.tool_call_id) !== message) continue;
508:     }

511:       message.role !== "assistant" ||
512:       !message.tool_calls ||

542: // Responses input normalizer: Codex sends an enriched Responses journal
543: // (agent_message, compaction, reasoning with encrypted blobs, etc.) that is
544: // not valid for a raw upstream Responses call (Meta/Go validates strictly:
545: // `input[12] did not match any supported type`). This mirrors buildMessages
546: // but emits valid Responses items instead of Chat messages.
547: // assistant messages must use output_text, user/system/developer use input_text
548: // (Meta validates: `input_text is not valid on assistant messages`).
549: function partToResponses(part, model, role) {
550:   if (!part || typeof part !== "object") return undefined;
551:   const isAssistant = role === "assistant";
552:   if (part.type === "input_text" || part.type === "output_text") {
553:     if (typeof part.text === "string") return { type: isAssistant ? "output_text" : "input_text", text: part.text };

556:   if (part.type === "input_image") {

559:       return { type: "input_image", image_url: url };

561:     return undefined;

588: export function buildResponsesInput({ input, model, supportsCustomTools = true }) {
589:   const out = [];
590:   const seenOutputs = new Set();

592:   for (const item of items) {
593:     if (!item || typeof item !== "object") continue;
594:     if (item.type === "reasoning") {
595:       // Preserve encrypted reasoning verbatim for Muse (store:false + include)
596:       const hasSummary = Array.isArray(item.summary) || typeof item.summary === "string";
597:       const hasEncrypted = typeof item.encrypted_content === "string" && item.encrypted_content.length > 0;
598:       if (!hasSummary && !hasEncrypted) {
599:         const text = reasoningItemText(item);
600:         if (!text) continue;
601:         out.push({ type: "reasoning", id: item.id || undefined, summary: [{ type: "summary_text", text }] });
602:       } else {
603:         const r = { type: "reasoning" };
604:         if (item.id) r.id = item.id;
605:         if (Array.isArray(item.summary)) r.summary = item.summary;
606:         else if (typeof item.summary === "string") r.summary = [{ type: "summary_text", text: item.summary }];
607:         if (typeof item.encrypted_content === "string") r.encrypted_content = item.encrypted_content;
608:         // Content fallback
609:         if (!r.summary && item.content) {
610:           const t = reasoningItemText(item);
611:           if (t) r.summary = [{ type: "summary_text", text: t }];
612:         }
613:         out.push(r);
614:       }
615:       continue;
616:     }
617:     if (item.type === "function_call" || item.type === "custom_tool_call") {
618:       // Responses has no namespace wrapper: replay namespaced Codex calls with
619:       // the same flat name used in the native tool definition.
620:       const call = { ...item };
621:       if (typeof call.namespace === "string" && typeof call.name === "string" && !call.name.includes(COLLABORATION_TOOL_DELIMITER)) {

624:       }
625:       if (!supportsCustomTools && call.type === "custom_tool_call") {
626:         call.type = "function_call";
627:         call.arguments = JSON.stringify({ content: typeof call.input === "string" ? call.input : "" });

629:       } else if (call.type === "function_call") {
630:         call.arguments = normalizeFunctionArguments(call.arguments);
631:       }
632:       out.push(call);
633:       continue;
634:     }
635:     if (item.type === "function_call_output" || item.type === "custom_tool_call_output") {
636:       const callId = item.call_id || item.id;
637:       if (!callId || seenOutputs.has(callId)) continue;
638:       seenOutputs.add(callId);

645:         if (Array.isArray(output)) {

654:         type: !supportsCustomTools && item.type === "custom_tool_call_output" ? "function_call_output" : item.type,

670:         continue;
671:       }
672:       out.push({ type: "message", role, content: parts });
673:       continue;
674:     }
675:     if (item.type === "agent_message") {
676:       const text = agentMessageText(item);
677:       if (text) out.push({ type: "message", role: "user", content: [{ type: "input_text", text }] });
678:       continue;
679:     }

333: // Plain `codex debug models` returns the effective catalog, which includes
334: // our own merged file (Codex loads it via model_catalog_json). The fake
335: // binary below reproduces that: --bundled is pristine, plain is polluted
336: // with a stale declared model. Capture must prefer --bundled so removed
337: // models never resurrect in the native cache.
338: function writeFakeCodexBin(dir, { failBundled = false } = {}) {
339:   const fakeBin = path.join(dir, "codex");
340:   writeFileSync(
341:     fakeBin,
342:     `#!/usr/bin/env bun
343: const args = process.argv.slice(2);
344: if (${failBundled ? "true" : "false"} && args.includes("--bundled")) process.exit(1);
345: const pristine = { models: [{ slug: "gpt-5.6-sol", display_name: "GPT-5.6 Sol", visibility: "list", priority: 1, supported_in_api: true }] };
346: const polluted = { models: [...pristine.models, { slug: "deepseek-flash", display_name: "V4 Flash", visibility: "list", priority: 1, supported_in_api: true }] };
347: console.log(JSON.stringify(args.includes("--bundled") ? pristine : polluted));
348: `,
349:   );
350:   chmodSync(fakeBin, 0o755);
351:   return fakeBin;
352: }

1: // Shared bridge for "custom" (freeform) tools such as exec. Chat-completions
2: // providers can only express function tools, so custom tools are advertised as
3: // functions with a single `content` string property; when the model calls one,
4: // the raw payload is recovered from that property and delivered to the host as
5: // a `custom_tool_call` item, which is the shape the app's tool router expects
6: // for freeform tools. Mirrors the proven LiteLLM bridge so the streaming and
7: // non-streaming response paths share one code path.
8: 
9: export function extractCustomToolNames(tools) {
10:   const names = new Set();
11:   if (!Array.isArray(tools)) return names;
12:   for (const tool of tools) {
13:     if (
14:       tool &&
15:       typeof tool === "object" &&
16:       tool.type === "custom" &&
17:       typeof tool.name === "string"
18:     ) {
19:       names.add(tool.name);
20:     }
21:   }
22:   return names;
23: }
24: 
25: const MAX_ARGUMENTS_LEN = 1_000_000;
26: 
27: export function unwrapCustomToolArguments(argumentsString) {
28:   if (!argumentsString) return "";
29:   if (argumentsString.length > MAX_ARGUMENTS_LEN) return argumentsString;
30:   try {
31:     const parsed = JSON.parse(argumentsString);
32:     if (parsed && typeof parsed === "object" && typeof parsed.content === "string") {
33:       return parsed.content;
34:     }
35:   } catch {
36:     // Not JSON; the raw arguments string is the input.
37:   }
38:   return argumentsString;
39: }
40: 
41: function normalizeToolArguments(args) {
42:   if (args === undefined || args === null) return "{}";
43:   if (typeof args === "string") {
44:     const trimmed = args.trim();
45:     if (!trimmed) return "{}";
46:     try {
47:       JSON.parse(trimmed);
48:       return trimmed;
49:     } catch {
50:       return "{}";
51:     }
52:   }
53:   if (typeof args === "object") {
54:     try {
55:       const s = JSON.stringify(args);
56:       if (s) {
57:         JSON.parse(s);
58:         return s;
59:       }
60:     } catch {}
61:     return "{}";
62:   }
63:   return "{}";
64: }
65: 
66: export function toolCallItem({ callId, name, args, status, customNames }) {
67:   const custom = customNames instanceof Set && customNames.has(name);
68:   const item = {
69:     id: callId,
70:     type: custom ? "custom_tool_call" : "function_call",
71:     status,
72:     call_id: callId,
73:     name,
74:   };
75:   if (custom) {
76:     item.input = status === "completed" ? unwrapCustomToolArguments(args) : "";
77:   } else {
78:     item.arguments = normalizeToolArguments(args);
79:   }

88: export const NATIVE_CATALOG_PATH = path.join(STATE_DIR, "native-models.json");

98: function pinnedNativeCatalog() {
99:   const pinned = process.env.CODEXTRAS_NATIVE_CATALOG;
100:   if (!pinned || !existsSync(pinned)) return undefined;

108: export function captureNativeCatalog() {
109:   const pinned = pinnedNativeCatalog();
110:   if (pinned) return pinned;
111:   const binary = codexBinary();
112:   const run = (args) =>
113:     execFileSync(binary, args, {
114:       encoding: "utf8",
115:       timeout: 30_000,
116:       maxBuffer: 32 * 1024 * 1024,
117:     });
118:   let output;
119:   try {
120:     // Prefer the pristine bundled catalog. Plain `debug models` returns the
121:     // effective catalog, which includes our own merged file (Codex loads it
122:     // via model_catalog_json); caching that as "native" resurrects removed
123:     // declared models and pins stale entries in every later merge.
124:     output = run(["debug", "models", "--bundled"]);
125:   } catch {

129:   if (!parsed || !Array.isArray(parsed.models) || parsed.models.length === 0) {
130:     throw new Error("Codex returned an empty model catalog.");
131:   }
132:   return parsed;

135: export function cacheNativeCatalog(parsed) {
136:   mkdirSync(STATE_DIR, { recursive: true });
137:   writeFileSync(
138:     NATIVE_CATALOG_PATH,
139:     JSON.stringify(parsed, null, 2) + "\n",
140:     { mode: 0o600 },

144: export function cachedNativeCatalog() {
145:   if (!existsSync(NATIVE_CATALOG_PATH)) return undefined;
146:   try {
147:     return JSON.parse(readFileSync(NATIVE_CATALOG_PATH, "utf8"));
148:   } catch {
149:     return undefined;

153: export function mergeCatalog(config, nativeOverride) {
154:   const declared = generateCatalog(config.models).models;
155:   const declaredSlugs = new Set(declared.map((m) => m.slug));
156:   const native = nativeOverride || cachedNativeCatalog();
157:   const overrides = config.catalogOverrides || {};
158:   const models = [];
159:   for (const model of Array.isArray(native && native.models) ? native.models : []) {
160:     if (model && typeof model.slug === "string" && !declaredSlugs.has(model.slug)) {
161:       const override = overrides[model.slug];
162:       models.push(override && typeof override === "object" ? { ...model, ...override } : model);
163:     }
164:   }
165:   models.push(...declared);
166:   return { models };
167: }

170:   const merged = mergeCatalog(config);
171:   mkdirSync(path.dirname(target), { recursive: true });
172:   writeFileSync(target, JSON.stringify(merged, null, 2) + "\n", { mode: 0o600 });

console.log(\\\"Bun inflate node-comp ok\\\", d3.length===buf.length); } catch(e){ console.log(\\\"Bun inflate node-comp fail\\\", e.message); }\\n} catch(e){ console.log(\\\"deflate err\\\", e.message); }\\n// br\\ntry {\\n  const c = zlib.brotliCompressSync(buf);\\n  console.log(\\\"node br comp\\\", c.length);\\n  const d = zlib.brotliDecompressSync(c);\\n  console.log(\\\"node br roundtrip\\\", d.length===buf.length);\\n} catch(e){ console.log(\\\"br err\\\", e.message); args: {"code":"const r = await tools.bash({command: 'cat > /tmp/probe2.mjs <<\\'EOF\\'\\nconsole.log(\\\"Bun keys:\\\", Object.keys(Bun).filter(k=>/brotli|gzip|gunzip|inflate|deflate|zstd/i.test(k)));\\nimport * as zlib from \\\"node:zlib\\\";\\nconsole.log(\\\"zlib zstd:\\\", typeof zlib.zstdDecompressSync, typeof zlib.zstdCompressSync);\\nconsole.log(\\\"zlib gzip:\\\", typeof zlib.gunzipSync, typeof zlib.gzipSync);\\nconsole.log(\\\"zlib br:\\\", typeof zlib.brotliDecompressSync);\\n// roundtrip tests\\nconst payload = JSON.stringify({hello:\\\"world \\\".repeat(50)});\\nconst buf = Buffer.from(payload);\\n// zstd via Bun\\ntry {\\n  const c = Buffer.from(Bun.zstdCompressSync(buf));\\n  console.log(\\\"Bun zstd comp\\\", c.length, \\\"magic\\\", Array.from(c.slice(0,4)));\\n  const d = Buffer.from(Bun.zstdDecompressSync(c));\\n  console.log(\\\"Bun zstd roundtrip ok:\\\", d.toString().slice(0,30));\\n  // via node:zlib?\\n  const d2 = zlib.zstdDecompressSync(c);\\n  console.log(\\\"node zstdDecompress Bun-comp ok:\\\", d2.toString().slice(0,30));\\n  const c2 = zlib.zstdCompressSync(buf);\\n  console.log(\\\"node zstd comp\\\", c2.length);\\n  const d3 = Buffer.from(Bun.zstdDecompressSync(c2));\\n  console.log(\\\"Bun decomp node-comp ok:\\\", d3.toString().slice(0,30));\\n} catch(e){ console.log(\\\"zstd err\\\", e.message, e.stack?.slice(0,300)); }\\n// gzip via Bun vs node\\ntry {\\n  const c = Buffer.from(Bun.gzipSync(buf));\\n  console.log(\\\"Bun gzip\\\", c.length, \\\"magic\\\", Array.from(c.slice(0,2)));\\n  const d = Buffer.from(Bun.gunzipSync(c));\\n  console.log(\\\"Bun gzip roundtrip\\\", d.length===buf.length);\\n  const d2 = zlib.gunzipSync(c);\\n  console.log(\\\"node gunzip Bun-comp ok\\\", d2.length===buf.length);\\n} catch(e){ console.log(\\\"gzip err\\\", e.message); }\\n// deflate\\ntry {\\n  const c = Buffer.from(Bun.deflateSync(buf));\\n  console.log(\\\"Bun deflate\\\", c.length);\\n  const d = Buffer.from(Bun.inflateSync(c));\\n  console.log(\\\"Bun inflate ok\\\", d.length===buf.length);\\n  // node inflate?\\n  try { const d2 = zlib.inflateSync(c); console.log(\\\"node inflate Bun-comp ok\\\", d2.length===buf.length); } catch(e){ console.log(\\\"node inflate Bun-comp fail\\\", e.message); }\\n  const c2 = zlib.deflateSync(buf);\\n  console.log(\\\"node deflate\\\", c2.length);\\n  try { const d3 = Buffer.from(Bun.inflateSync(c2)); console.log(\\\"Bun inflate node-comp ok\\\", d3.length===buf.length); } catch(e){ console.log(\\\"Bun inflate node-comp fail\\\", e.message); }\\n} catch(e){ console.log(\\\"deflate err\\\", e.message); }\\n// br\\ntry {\\n  const c = zlib.brotliCompressSync(buf);\\n  console.log(\\\"node br comp\\\", c.length);\\n  const d = zlib.brotliDecompressSync(c);\\n  console.log(\\\"node br roundtrip\\\", d.length===buf.length);\\n} catch(e){ console.log(\\\"br err\\\", e.message); }\\nEOF\\nbun /tmp/probe2.mjs 2>&1', description: 'Test decompress APIs'});\nconsole.log(JSON.stringify(r,null,2).slice(0,10000));\n"

data.arguments: {"code":"const r = await tools.bash({command: 'cat > /tmp/probe2.mjs <<\\'EOF\\'\\nconsole.log(\\\"Bun keys:\\\", Object.keys(Bun).filter(k=>/brotli|gzip|gunzip|inflate|deflate|zstd/i.test(k)));\\nimport * as zlib from \\\"node:zlib\\\";\\nconsole.log(\\\"zlib zstd:\\\", typeof zlib.zstdDecompressSync, typeof zlib.zstdCompressSync);\\nconsole.log(\\\"zlib gzip:\\\", typeof zlib.gunzipSync, typeof zlib.gzipSync);\\nconsole.log(\\\"zlib br:\\\", typeof zlib.brotliDecompressSync);\\n// roundtrip tests\\nconst payload = JSON.stringify({hello:\\\"world \\\".repeat(50)});\\nconst buf = Buffer.from(payload);\\n// zstd via Bun\\ntry {\\n  const c = Buffer.from(Bun.zstdCompressSync(buf));\\n  console.log(\\\"Bun zstd comp\\\", c.length, \\\"magic\\\", Array.from(c.slice(0,4)));\\n  const d = Buffer.from(Bun.zstdDecompressSync(c));\\n  console.log(\\\"Bun zstd roundtrip ok:\\\", d.toString().slice(0,30));\\n  // via node:zlib?\\n  const d2 = zlib.zstdDecompressSync(c);\\n  console.log(\\\"node zstdDecompress Bun-comp ok:\\\", d2.toString().slice(0,30));\\n  const c2 = zlib.zstdCompressSync(buf);\\n  console.log(\\\"node zstd comp\\\", c2.length);\\n  const d3 = Buffer.from(Bun.zstdDecompressSync(c2));\\n  console.log(\\\"Bun decomp node-comp ok:\\\", d3.toString().slice(0,30));\\n} catch(e){ console.log(\\\"zstd err\\\", e.message, e.stack?.slice(0,300)); }\\n// gzip via Bun vs node\\ntry {\\n  const c = Buffer.from(Bun.gzipSync(buf));\\n  console.log(\\\"Bun gzip\\\", c.length, \\\"magic\\\", Array.from(c.slice(0,2)));\\n  const d = Buffer.from(Bun.gunzipSync(c));\\n  console.log(\\\"Bun gzip roundtrip\\\", d.length===buf.length);\\n  const d2 = zlib.gunzipSync(c);\\n  console.log(\\\"node gunzip Bun-comp ok\\\", d2.length===buf.length);\\n} catch(e){ console.log(\\\"gzip err\\\", e.message); }\\n// deflate\\ntry {\\n  const c = Buffer.from(Bun.deflateSync(buf));\\n  console.log(\\\"Bun deflate\\\", c.length);\\n  const d = Buffer.from(Bun.inflateSync(c));\\n  console.log(\\\"Bun inflate ok\\\", d.length===buf.length);\\n  // node inflate?\\n  try { const d2 = zlib.inflateSync(c); console.log(\\\"node inflate Bun-comp ok\\\", d2.length===buf.length); } catch(e){ console.log(\\\"node inflate Bun-comp fail\\\", e.message); }\\n  const c2 = zlib.deflateSync(buf);\\n  console.log(\\\"node deflate\\\", c2.length);\\n  try { const d3 = Buffer.from(Bun.inflateSync(c2)); console.log(\\\"Bun inflate node-comp ok\\\", d3.length===buf.length); } catch(e){ console.log(\\\"Bun inflate node-comp fail\\\", e.message); }\\n} catch(e){ console.log(\\\"deflate err\\\", e.message); }\\n// br\\ntry {\\n  const c = zlib.brotliCompressSync(buf);\\n  console.log(\\\"node br comp\\\", c.length);\\n  const d = zlib.brotliDecompressSync(c);\\n  console.log(\\\"node br roundtrip\\\", d.length===buf.length);\\n} catch(e){ console.log(\\\"br err\\\", e.message); }\\nEOF\\nbun /tmp/probe2.mjs 2>&1', description: 'Test decompress APIs'});\nconsole.log(JSON.stringify(r,null,2).slice(0,10000));\n","description":"Test decompress roundtrips"}

 if(res.status!==200) throw new Error(res.status);\\n});\\nawait check(\\\"array body still 400\\\", async()=>{\\n  const body=Buffer.from(zstdCompressSync(Buffer.from(JSON.stringify([1,2,3]))));\\n  const res=await fetch(base+\\\"/v1/responses\\\",{method:\\\"POST\\\",headers:{\\\"Content-Type\\\":\\\"application/json\\\",\\\"Content-Encoding\\\":\\\"zstd\\\"},body});\\n  if(res.status!==400) throw new Error(\\\"want 400 got \\\"+res.status);\\n});\\nawait check(\\\"number body still 400\\\", async()=>{\\n  const body=Buffer.from(zstdCompressSync(Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(123))));\\n  const res=await fetch(base+\\\"/v1/responses\\\",{method:\\\"POST\\\",headers:{\\\"Content-Type\\\":\\\"application/json\\\",\\\"Content-Encoding\\\":\\\"zstd\\\"},body});\\n  if(res.status!==400) throw new Error(\\\"want 400 got \\\"+res.status);\\n});\\nserver.stop(true); mock.stop(true);\\nconsole.log(\\\"done2\\\");\\nEOF\\nbun ./verify-zstd2.tmp.mjs 2>&1', description: 'Test compact and Fixed zstd-encoded request bodies crashing the gateway (`src/server.mjs` only, `bun test` 38/38 green).

Root cause: `Bun.serve` does not decompress inbound bodies (verified: `arrayBuffer()`/`req.json()` return raw zstd bytes, `Failed to parse JSON`), while `fetch` transparently decompresses upstream responses — so only the inbound path needed fixing. Compressed `POST /v1/responses[/compact]` bodies failed `JSON.parse` and returned `400 Request body must be a JSON object`, and compressed native-passthrough bodies were forwarded still-compressed.

Fix in `src/server.mjs`:
- Added `node:zlib`-based `decompressOnce` (zstd/gzip/deflate incl. raw-deflate fallback/br, case-insensitive, `identity` no-op, unknown → 400 not crash) plus `decodeRequestBody` which decodes `Content-Encoding` in reverse order and falls back to magic-byte sniffing (zstd `28 B5 2F FD`, gzip `1F 8B` — valid JSON can never start with these).
- Handler now parses `TextDecoder().decode(bodyBytes)` and forwards the decompressed `bodyBytes` to `handleTurn`/`handleCompaction`/`forwardNative`, so native passthrough receives plain JSON.

Verified: plain, `zstd`/`gzip`/`deflate`/`br` with header, headerless sniffing, uppercase `ZSTD`, `identity`, stacked `gzip, zstd`, streaming and compaction, native passthrough, and corrupt-body → clean 400 with gateway still alive.
